props.name: scale-factor
props.description: How much each card scales down per card (0.05 = 5% smaller each step).

props.name: gap
props.description: Vertical gap between stacked cards in pixels.

props.name: offset
props.description: Vertical offset between card positions in pixels.

props.name: top-offset
props.description: Initial top offset for the first card in pixels.

props.name: scroll-element
props.description: CSS selector for the scrollable container (defaults to window scroll).
